items.q: How much does a website in Sardinia cost with WebSardegna?
items.a: The professional website costs €500, with domain and hosting included for the first year. Extras (e-commerce, booking, languages, photos) are agreed upfront, in writing.

items.q: Do I have to pay upfront?
items.a: No. You get the draft free within 48 hours and pay only when you like the site and approve it.

items.q: What happens after the first year?
items.a: From year two, domain and hosting are renewed. We tell you the cost clearly in advance, with no surprise renewals.
The draft arrives within 48 hours of your first message. After approval the site usually goes live within a few days, depending on the changes requested.

items.q: Is the domain registered to me?
items.a: Yes. The domain belongs to your business: if you ever change provider, it goes with you.

items.q: Do you work all over Sardinia?
items.a: Yes, from Olbia to Cagliari, from Alghero to Nuoro. We work over WhatsApp and meet in person when needed.

items.q: Can I change the site after it’s live?
items.a: Of course. Small updates like hours or menu are quick; for bigger changes we agree time and cost first.

items.q: Does the site work well on phones?
items.a: Yes. Every site is designed for smartphones first, because that’s where most customers come from.

final.title: Got a business? Let’s put it online.
